title: Microsoft Purview - Simply Explained
description:
Firewalls do nothing once a trusted user moves sensitive data. This episode explains Microsoft Purview in simple terms for IT, security and compliance teams, showing how governance, sensitivity labels, DLP and Compliance Manager work together, including for Copilot and AI.
In this episode
00:00 – Why walls around data are not enough01:48 – Pillar 1: Data governance04:04 – Pillar 2: Sensitivity labels05:59 – Data loss prevention07:50 – Pillar 3: Data compliance10:50 – AI governance and Copilot13:25 – How the three pillars connect15:25 – Your first steps
Key takeaways
Microsoft Purview moves protection from the network to the data itself through governance, security and compliance.Sensitivity labels travel with documents and drive DLP policies, which you should test in simulation mode before enforcing.Copilot exposes unlabeled, overshared data, so start with a data classification scan and use Compliance Manager as your roadmap.
Worth quoting
“This is the fundamental shift. Protection needs to move from the infrastructure layer to the data layer itself. Instead of just guarding the building, you need to guard the files inside it.” – Mirko Peters (01:35)
“Here's the thing about labels, they travel with the data, if a document is marked confidential and someone attaches it to an email, the label stays attached.” – Mirko Peters (04:28)
Explore more on M365.FM
